'''Harok''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who served as a [[Colonel/Legends|colonel]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire's]] [[Imperial Military (Sith Empire)|military]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. In [[3643 BBY]] he was stationed on [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]] under order of [[Admiral/Legends|admiral]] [[Jefand Ange]], where along with [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Zavrasha]] he asked an Imperial to execute a series of strikes aimed to weaken the Republic forces on the planet.<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Colonel Harok appears in the ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' as an NPC on Nar Shaddaa and starts the planet's bonus series named "Shattering the Peace". Female characters have an option to flirt with him.<ref name="TOR" />
